app_release_line: 1.x (1.123.85 is the newest 1.x tag on Docker Hub; 2.x is current upstream)
base_image: Docker Hardened Images node 24.13.1 alpine 3.22 (image labels)
licence: Sustainable Use License 1.0, fair-code (upstream LICENSE.md); files with .ee in the name or directory are under the n8n Enterprise License and are not licensed for use without an enterprise key
database: SQLite (the image default, volume n8n-data at /home/node/.n8n)

notes: path=249 is the editor bundle (243 /assets files, 3 /static files), /types/nodes.json and /types/credentials.json (600 KB), and the /signin HTML shell

auth=6 is /rest/settings x3 (the front-end settings document; it also carries the telemetry client configuration), /rest/login x2 (POST sign-in, GET current user) and POST /rest/ai/sessions/metadata (403; 'session' in the path)
other-origin=1 is the editor fetching dynamic banners from api.n8n.io/api/banners (N8N_DYNAMIC_BANNERS_ENABLED was not set to false)
non-json=1 is GET /rest/external-secrets/secrets (404 HTML; an enterprise feature probed by the credentials page)

seeded_objects: owner Rea Admin (rea-admin@example.test); 5 tags (Granite Ledger, Blue Heron Kitchen, Lighthouse Rota, Saltmarsh Depot, Quarterly Audit); 4 workflows built from core nodes only, no credentials (Granite Ledger stone count digest, Blue Heron Kitchen sitting planner, Lighthouse Rota shift handover, Saltmarsh Depot barge drop log); 2 manual executions; 2 data tables (Lamp Oil Drops with 4 rows, Quarry Block Tally with 3 rows)

workflows.Blue Heron Kitchen sitting planner: Manual Trigger 'Start sitting plan' -> Edit Fields 'Plan tide-table sitting' (covers 36, head_cook Marisol Okonkwo-Reyes, broth smoked kelp) -> If 'More than 30 covers?' -> 'Open the second dining room' / 'Single room is enough'; tag Blue Heron Kitchen; executed once (success)
workflows.Lighthouse Rota shift handover: Schedule Trigger 'Every night at 22:00' (cron, inactive) -> Edit Fields 'Write handover note' (shift three, hands over 06:00, tide tables Ada Finch); tag Lighthouse Rota
workflows.Saltmarsh Depot barge drop log: Manual Trigger 'Start drop log' -> Edit Fields 'Record barge drop' (barge Pale Meridian, berth B4, 6 drums, barge master Tomas Vey); tags Saltmarsh Depot, Quarterly Audit

data_tables.Lamp Oil Drops: columns lighthouse, litres, barge, signed_by; rows Granite Point Light 180 Pale Meridian Ada Finch / Tidewater Steps Light 165 Pale Meridian Rui Castellanos / Copperfield Beacon 140 Ember Compass Mina Okafor / Saltmarsh Bar Light 120 Ember Compass Tomas Vey

seeded_objects_detail.no_second_user: an invitation would add an inviteAcceptUrl (a sign-up link for that instance) to every /rest/users reply, so the instance has the owner only
seeded_objects_detail.scratch_during_capture: tag Rea scratch tag created (POST), renamed (PATCH), listed, deleted (DELETE {data:true}), listed; workflow Rea scratch workflow created (POST), renamed (PATCH with versionId), read, archived (POST /archive), deleted (DELETE), re-read (404)
